roleContext.jobDescription: A collaboration-software company maintains a shared design system used by six product teams and about 70 frontend engineers. The frontend engineer on the design-system team builds React and TypeScript components, audits interfaces against WCAG 2.2 AA, writes visual regression and unit tests, documents components on the design-system site and mentors junior engineers through structured code review and pairing. Two graduate engineers join the team each autumn, and each is assigned a mentor who pairs with them weekly and reviews their first components before release.

requirements.text: Builds and maintains React components in the company design system with TypeScript.
Audits interfaces against WCAG 2.2 AA and fixes accessibility defects.
Mentors junior engineers through structured code review and pairing.
Writes visual regression and unit tests for components.
Writes component documentation on the design-system site.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Frontend Engineer, Design System

## Experience

- Frontend engineer at Quillstack (project-management software), May 2021 to present, building React and TypeScript components for the company's design system, including the date picker, data table and toast notifications.
- Audited the checkout and account-settings flows against WCAG 2.2 AA and fixed 37 defects, including focus order, colour contrast and form error announcements.
- Added visual regression tests for 60 design-system components and unit tests for keyboard interaction on every interactive component.
- Wrote usage guidance, do-and-don't examples and prop tables for the design-system documentation site, and added a keyboard-interaction section to each interactive component's page.
- Reviewed pull requests from other frontend engineers on the design-system repository as one of four code owners.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the pairing-session facilitator's feedback form from the candidate's mock pairing session at the assessment centre: 'A natural mentor with infectious energy; our juniors would love learning from them. Warm, patient manner, and clearly someone who enjoys explaining things to people newer to the craft.'
